description.text: Main coursesChinese cultural education courses: Overview of China, Chinese language, etc.Basic medical courses: Medical Basic Chemistry, Medical Organic Chemistry, Advanced Medical Mathematics, Medical Physics, Fundamentals of Computer Application, Human Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Human Physiology, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Microbiology and Parasitology, Pathology, Pharmacology, Pathophysiology, Medical Immunology, Medical Genetics, etc.Courses in behavioral science, humanities and social sciences, and medical ethics: Medical psychology, medical ethics, etc.Preventive medicine courses: Preventive medicine, Epidemiology, Medical Statistics, etc. Clinical medicine courses: Diagnostics, Imaging Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Pediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Neurology, Ophthalmology, Otorhinolaryngology, Stomatology, Dermatology and Venereology, Psychiatry and Mental Health, Anesthesiology, Emergency Medicine, Rehabilitation Medicine, Traditional Chinese Medicine, etc.

duration.text: The MBBS at Guangzhou Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. A scanned copy of the information page of a valid passport;2. Proof of the highest academic degree, transcripts of all courses during the highest academic degree education stage (original scanned copies and English translations);3. Id photo (2-inch blue-background, bareheaded photo);4. Scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners", which must be filled out in either Chinese or English;5. English self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);6. Proof of language proficiency;7. Scanned copies of the "Economic Guarantee Letter" and its guarantee materials, which must be filled out in Chinese or English;8. Two copies of the "Guardian's Guarantee Letter" (which must be notarized), signed (provided by applicants under the age of 18 by October 20, 2025. If the notarization location is not in China, the notarization mark of the Chinese embassy or consulate in the local area must also be affixed).9. Non-recent graduates must provide their personal resumes.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese nationals holding valid passports or nationality certificates.2. Aged 18 to 25, with a high school diploma or above.3. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.4. Be friendly to China, diligent and eager to learn, have good academic performance, upright conduct, abide by laws and regulations, have no record of violating school rules and regulations, and have no criminal record.5. Language proficiency requirements: Applicants whose native language is English are exempt from providing proof of English language proficiency. Applicants whose native language is not English must have proof of IELTS Academic test scores (not lower than 6.0, with no individual score lower than 5.0), TOEFL (Internet based test not lower than 70, with no individual score lower than 15), or other equivalent English test scores (70 (inclusive) or above on a 100-point scale). Applicants whose native language is not English and whose highest academic qualification was taught in English do not need to provide IELTS/TOEFL scores, but they must submit proof of the language of instruction.
